title: DeepDRR
paper_title: DeepDRR: A Catalyst for Machine Learning in Fluoroscopy-Guided Procedures
core_mech: DeepDRR 不是纯 GAN 渲染器，而是 3D 材料分解网络、解析材料/能谱 ray tracing、学习散射和解析噪声的组合 forward model。
core_mech_en: Physics-based X-ray fluoroscopy simulator combining CNN 3D tissue material decomposition, analytical energy-dependent Beer–Lambert ray-casting, learned Rayleigh/Compton scatter, and quantum noise.
input_desc: 患者 CT、X-ray 源—探测器几何、能谱和曝光参数
input_en: Volumetric 3D CT scan, C-arm source–detector geometry, X-ray spectrum E, and photon flux
output_desc: 含材料衰减、散射和噪声的逼真数字重建 X-ray/fluoroscopy
output_en: Photorealistic synthetic fluoroscopy / Digitally Reconstructed Radiograph (DRR) with physical scatter and noise

source.title: DeepDRR
notes: This is an open-source copyleft license, not a noncommercial license. 'restricted' means obligations beyond retaining a notice; review its source-sharing and compatibility requirements before vendoring.

gaps: DeepDRR includes calibrated geometry, material decomposition/scatter and physical image formation. The differentiable toy ray projectors here are not a DeepDRR replacement.
